turns.text: Classify this support ticket into exactly one label: billing | bug | account | data | sync | permissions. Ticket: 'The route map tile takes over a minute to appear but renders correctly in the end.' Reply with the label only.

For the desk records, the standing desk guide: freezes, crashes and unresponsive controls are bug; charges, refunds and invoices are billing; sign-in and access problems are account; stale or missing content inside reports and exports is data, because it traces to the update pipeline - do not use bug for views that work but show old or slow figures. Note the guide in one line.

Desk bulletin, verified service notice: the mapping provider confirmed a caching defect on their side; from here on, views that load slowly but finish follow the same rule as stale exports. Amend your records in one line.
